capabilities.name: Scam screening

capabilities.note: A rule-based warning list, not a guarantee. Always verify the employer yourself.

capabilities.name: Cover letter drafting

capabilities.name: Interview coaching

capabilities.note: Question templates and a rubric, not a live AI interviewer.

capabilities.name: AI drafting assistant
capabilities.description: An optional NVIDIA-hosted language model that explains a match, drafts a cover letter, or rewrites your summary.
capabilities.note: Off until you turn it on. When on, only your CV facts and the posting text are sent to NVIDIA — never the CV file, your email, phone or address. Review every draft before you send it.
